title: kbmon live beside the chat, a tiny receipt for the agent
goal: an interactive Claude Code session in the clone shows kbmon live in the pane of a kbmon-pane mod, refreshed on a timer and laid out again at the pane's width after a resize; kbmon.py --split opens the live view beside the session in WezTerm, tmux or Windows Terminal and prints the command to run elsewhere; the agent gets one redacted kbmon receipt line at SessionStart and one async line only when the alert set changes; headless claude -p sessions and sprint workers get no receipt and start no pane timer
